chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf narrated to us, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washha', from Muhammad ibn Qasim ibn al-Fadl, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): May I be sacrificed for you, what is the meaning of the saying of Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him and his Family): 'Indeed, Fatima shielded her private organ, so Allah forbade her offspring from the Fire'?
He said: Those who are freed from the Fire are the children from her belly: al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Zaynab, and Umm Kulthum.
ai.seo_question: Who are the specific offspring of Fatima al-Zahra that are freed from the Fire according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to clarify the specific scope of the Prophet's promise that Fatima's offspring would be shielded from Hellfire, identifying them as her four direct children. This interpretation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of linking the Imams' spiritual purity and intercessory status directly to their mother's unique virtue of chastity. The hadith thus serves as a theological foundation for the belief in the exceptional status of the Ahl al-Bayt.
